name: Rakuten American Express Card

apr.notes: 19.74%–33.99% variable APR for Purchases, based on creditworthiness; will vary with the market based on the Prime Rate (official Rakuten American Express Card disclosure box, as of 2026-07-25).

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees — 'American Express will not charge any foreign transaction fee on the purchases you make outside of the United States with your Card' (official Rakuten American Express Card Rewards Program Terms).

base_rate.description: 1% Cash Back on all other eligible purchases.

categories.label: Eligible Rakuten purchases (online and in-store), extra Cash Back up to $10,000 per calendar year (cap was $7,000 before July 15, 2026)

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash Back Rewards are issued and redeemed through the cardholder's linked Rakuten account per Rakuten Terms & Conditions.

signup_bonus.description: Get a $100 bonus when you spend $1,000 in the first 90 days on your Rakuten Card. Bonus awarded as Cash Back after the 90-day qualification period.

notes: Rakuten American Express Card (launched July 2025). Issued by First Electronic Bank pursuant to a license from American Express; powered by Imprint Payments. No annual fee. Cash Back is issued/redeemed via the cardholder's linked Rakuten account (not Membership Rewards). Earn rates and issuer verified against the official Rakuten rewards program terms page and PR Newswire launch release; the 4% Rakuten-purchase cap increased from $7,000 to $10,000 per calendar year effective July 15, 2026. APR, no-foreign-transaction-fee, and the current $100/$1,000/90-day welcome offer re-verified 2026-07-25 against the official Rakuten American Express Card product page (Schumer disclosure box and offer banner) and the official Imprint Rewards Program Terms; these supersede the prior NerdWallet-sourced APR and the $25 launch offer. Card art is served only from Rakuten's Webflow marketing CDN (not an issuer-domain asset), so image.url remains null.
